kangaroo-at-2014-01.prompt: Arno lays out the word KANGAROO using 8 cards. However, some cards are turned. By turning it twice, the letter K can be corrected; the letter A can be corrected by turning it once (see the drawing). How many turns does he need in total so that the word KANGAROO can be read correctly?

kangaroo-at-2014-02.prompt: A cake weighs 900 g. Paul cuts it into 4 pieces. The biggest piece weighs exactly as much as the other three pieces together. How much does the biggest piece weigh?

kangaroo-at-2014-03.prompt: A white and a grey ring are linked together. Peter sees the two rings from the front, as shown in the top picture. Paul sees the rings from the back. What does he see?

kangaroo-at-2014-04.prompt: In the addition sum shown, three digits have been replaced with stars. What is the sum of the three missing digits?

kangaroo-at-2014-05.prompt: What is the difference between the smallest five-digit number and the biggest four-digit number?

kangaroo-at-2014-06.prompt: A square with perimeter 48 cm is cut into two equal pieces with one cut. The pieces are put together to make a rectangle, as shown in the diagram. What is the perimeter of that rectangle?

kangaroo-at-2014-07.prompt: Katrin has 38 matches. She uses all the matches to make a triangle and a square. The triangle and the square do not share any matches. Each side of the triangle consists of 6 matches. How many matches make up one side of the square?

kangaroo-at-2014-08.prompt: Grey and white pearls are threaded on a piece of string. Monika wants to have 5 grey pearls. However, she can only pull pearls off the ends of the string, so she has to pull off some white pearls as well. What is the smallest number of white pearls she has to pull off to get 5 grey pearls?

kangaroo-at-2014-09.prompt: The little witch is taking part in a broomstick flying race with 5 rounds. The table shows the times at which she crossed the starting line (Zeit = time; Start = start; nach Runde 1 = after round 1, and so on). Which round was her fastest?

kangaroo-at-2014-10.prompt: Which square has to replace the question mark so that the white area and the black area are the same size?

kangaroo-at-2014-11.prompt: In a holiday camp, 7 children eat ice cream every day and 9 children eat ice cream every other day. The remaining children don't eat ice cream at all. Yesterday 13 children ate ice cream. How many children will eat ice cream today?

kangaroo-at-2014-12.prompt: The kangaroos A, B, C, D and E sit in this order clockwise around a round table. When a bell sounds, all but one of the kangaroos swap seats with a neighbour. Afterwards they sit in this order clockwise: A, E, B, D, C. Which kangaroo did not change places?

kangaroo-at-2014-13.prompt: A square can be made out of four of the pieces shown. Which piece will not be used?

kangaroo-at-2014-14.prompt: When the three digits of a three-digit number are multiplied, you get 135. What do you get when you add the three digits?

kangaroo-at-2014-15.prompt: A restaurant has 16 tables, each with either 3, 4 or 6 chairs. The tables with 3 or 4 chairs seat 36 guests in total. The whole restaurant seats 72 guests. How many tables have three chairs?

kangaroo-at-2014-16.prompt: The points A, B, C, D, E, F lie on a straight line in this order. These distances are known: AF = 35, AC = 12, BD = 11, CE = 12 and DF = 16. What is the distance BE?

kangaroo-at-2014-17.prompt: Lea plays with her marbles. She puts them in small groups on the table. If she makes groups of three, two marbles are left over. If she makes groups of five, again two are left over. How many more marbles does Lea need at least so that she can make groups of three and also groups of five with no marbles left over?

kangaroo-at-2014-18.prompt: The faces of a die are labelled with the numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. Faces 1 and 6 share an edge. The same is true for faces 1 and 5, faces 1 and 2, faces 6 and 5, faces 6 and 4, and faces 6 and 2. Which number is on the face opposite face 4?

kangaroo-at-2014-19.prompt: The $3 \times 3 \times 3$ cube is made of 27 small cubes. Some of the small cubes are removed. Now, if you look at the cube from the right, from above and from the front, each time you see the view shown below the cube. How many small cubes were removed?

kangaroo-at-2014-20.prompt: There are 5 songs on an MP3 player: song A lasts 3 min, song B 2 min 30 s, song C 2 min, song D 1 min 30 s and song E 4 min. The 5 songs are played non-stop one after the other, over and over. Song C is playing when Andy leaves the house. Exactly one hour later he comes back. Which song is playing when Andy comes back?

kangaroo-at-2014-21.prompt: Daniela fills a $3 \times 3$ table with the digits 1 to 9, one digit in each square. She has already placed 1, 2, 3 and 4 as shown. Two numbers are called neighbours if their squares share a side. When she has finished, she notices that the neighbours of 5 add up to 9. What is the sum of the neighbours of 6?

kangaroo-at-2014-22.prompt: The king travels with his messengers at a speed of 5 km/h from his castle to his summer residence. Every hour he sends a messenger back to the castle at a speed of 10 km/h. How much time passes between two messengers arriving at the castle one after the other?

kangaroo-at-2014-23.prompt: Mia writes three single-digit numbers on the board. Ali adds them and gets 15. Then he deletes one of the three numbers and replaces it with the number 3. Resi multiplies the three numbers now on the board and gets 36. Which number could Ali have deleted?

kangaroo-at-2014-24.prompt: Grandma gives 180 marbles to her ten grandchildren. No two children get the same number of marbles. Anna gets the most. What is the smallest number of marbles Anna could get?
